annotations.title: Add a ChatGPT Ads ad group

description: Add an ad group to an existing ChatGPT Ads campaign. Created PAUSED by default. Bidding: leave it out and the ad group gets INTELLIGENT BIDDING (OpenAI’s renamed “Maximize results”: maximize_clicks / maximize_conversions, no amount; needs a daily campaign budget). From 2026-11-09: bidStrategy target_cpa + targetCpa (conversions campaigns) or target_cpc + targetCpc (clicks campaigns). A fixed maxBid is Max Bid / Max CPC, deprecated and retired by ChatGPT Ads on 2027-01-01. The reply says if ChatGPT Ads stored a different bid than was sent. Its context hints ARE the targeting on this platform: up to 2,000 natural-language descriptions of the conversations, topics or questions where this offering is relevant — not exact-match keywords, and no guarantee of delivery. Write many distinct ones rather than variations of the same phrase. If the parent campaign is already LIVE (active), creating this ad group active starts REAL AD SPEND on the next auction, exactly like activating it — show the user what would begin serving, get an explicit yes, then pass confirm:true. Leaving it paused never needs confirmation. The whole tree is READ BACK from OpenAI before you are told it exists.

audienceBidMultipliers.description: bid more or less for people in a custom audience (eligible ids: list_openai_ads_audiences with intendedUse bid_multiplier, about 25,000 matched users). On an update this REPLACES the list; [] removes them all, and a bid change keeps the existing multipliers.

customAudienceId.description: custom audience id to bid more or less for, from list_openai_ads_audiences

multiplier.description: 0.1 to 10; 2 bids twice as much for this audience

bidStrategy.description: HOW THIS AD GROUP BIDS. OMIT IT (and maxBid) and a clicks or conversions campaign with a DAILY budget gets INTELLIGENT BIDDING — OpenAI’s new name for “Maximize results”: maximize_clicks / maximize_conversions, no amount. From 2026-11-09 OpenAI adds COST TARGETS: target_cpa with targetCpa (conversions campaigns) and target_cpc with targetCpc (clicks campaigns); OpenAI may bid above or below the target in any one auction, so set it from the recent actual CPA/CPC in openai_ads_report. An account OpenAI has not switched on yet is refused with that date. fixed_bid (with maxBid) is Max Bid / Max CPC: DEPRECATED, retired by ChatGPT Ads on 2027-01-01 and refused from then — do not choose it for a new ad group except on an impressions campaign. The strategy must match the campaign: maximize_clicks / target_cpc need biddingType clicks, maximize_conversions / target_cpa need conversions.

campaignId.description: campaign id to add the ad group to

confirm.description: REQUIRED true to create this ACTIVE under a live campaign (real spend)

landingPageQueryTemplate.description: query string added to every landing page click, e.g. utm_source=chatgpt&utm_content={ad_id}. Placeholders: {campaign_id} {ad_group_id} {ad_id} {ad_account_id} {oppref}; oppref and olref cannot be parameter names. On an update, an empty string clears it.

maxBid.description: DEPRECATED — Max Bid / Max CPC, retired by ChatGPT Ads on 2027-01-01: a fixed bid in the account currency (bidStrategy fixed_bid; on a conversions campaign it is the CPA bid). Needed only on an impressions campaign (per impression); otherwise use intelligent bidding or a target.

targetCpa.description: Target CPA in the account currency: the average cost per conversion OpenAI aims for (bidStrategy target_cpa, conversions campaign, from 2026-11-09). Billing stays per click. Not with maxBid.

targetCpc.description: Target CPC in the account currency: the average cost per click OpenAI aims for (bidStrategy target_cpc, clicks campaign, from 2026-11-09). Not with maxBid.
